prompt: Please generate an image. Use the attached image(s) only as reference as described; the first attachment is always the style reference for palette, rendering and light. Keep the exact body design of the people in the second attachment. Character customization sheet, landscape 16:9, plain light neutral grey background, small neat labels. ROOTWARDENS: broad, stocky people with bark-grained wooden skin on which moss, lichen and small flowers grow; treetenders, herbalists and healers of the root caverns. Show the SIGNATURE FEATURE variants as a grid of heads and shoulders: wood types oak, birch, cedar and ashen, bark patterns, growth of moss, lichen, flowers and mushrooms, foliage beards, crystal inlays, and one character in four seasons: spring blossom, summer green, autumn leaves, winter bare. Also show male, female and elder body variants full-body in a row.
